title: Input source list
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t,p\in\mathbb{N}$. The input source list at time $t$ and position $p$ consists, in order, of constants indicating whether $t=0$, $p=1$, $p=0$, $p=|\ell|+1$, and $1\le p\le |\ell|$; the source $\ell_{p-1}$ when $1\le p\le |\ell|$, and the false constant otherwise; the three input-history sources at positions $p-1,p,p+1$ with their respective time and boundary flags; the two instruction-history sources at position $p$ with indices $1$ and $2$; followed by the previous-snapshot sources at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the input-history, instruction-history, or previous-snapshot source constructions, so their outputs can only be specified by their roles and arguments.
